description: General Corporate income statement presentation skeleton. Concept mappings are provisional; company presentation and taxonomy definitions require review. Groups and nesting do not imply arithmetic or concept equivalence. Unusual income / expenses contains candidate classifications only, does not assert nonrecurrence, and is not an additional subtotal. Review concepts must be resolved before use in calculated totals. Supplementary details may overlap primary statement amounts.

metadata_notes.period_and_unit: Period and unit types checked against the 2026 taxonomy. Historical filings require their own taxonomy context.
metadata_notes.contra: False does not prescribe fact signs or distinguish income from expense; these nodes do not represent intrinsic deduction balances.
metadata_notes.review_reasons: Review reasons record filing checks still required; they do not resolve accounting classification.
